Squad programming chat

Describe how your squad should fight. Your free local model drafts SquadScript; review it before applying.

Model runs on your phone or computer. No hosted chatbot.

SquadScript editor

One safe custom language controls the squad. Ask the local chatbot or edit orders directly. Latest matching active orders take priority, with 3 / 5 / 7 slots per star tier.

Order script reference

leader tank-1
all focus nearest | weakest | leader
all follow leader
infantry protect leader
sniper hold 360
helicopter flank leader
all retreat below 25%
all stance rush | balanced | sniper

★ latest 3 active orders · ★★ latest 5 · ★★★ latest 7. Leader designation does not use an order slot. Open the grouped function guide for 50 additional functions and conditions.

SquadScript function guide

Squad & combine

Buy team slots in the store, up to 15 units. Combine 3 of the same type and star tier into one stronger unit. Every deployed unit fights together. Select a unit for its stats and loadout; the squad uses one shared order script. Your collection is saved on this device.

★ Scan, Fire, Move · ★★ adds Cover and Dodge · ★★★ adds Precision aim and Retreat. Every run starts with one tank. Recruit units from random victory rewards.

Multiplayer arena

Invite matches run on the match server. Use the hosted game for internet invites, or the local bridge for USB tests. Both players submit their squad; the server controls combat and reports the result.

Armory & cosmetics

Gear changes stats. Squad orders control coordination. Drag owned gear onto a slot, or tap Equip. Select units in Squad & combine.

Retirement & cosmetics

Unit transfer

Export your collection or paste a validated unit collection to import. Programs and equipment are included. Imported progression is for local play.

Quartermaster store

Earn credits by winning arena levels. Credits and purchased slots are saved on this device. No real-money purchases.

Extra team slot

Reserve recruits

When your team is full, recruits wait here. Buy a slot or combine units, then move them to the team.

Arena victory

Choose your next tactic

Every victory gives one unit reward AND one instruction upgrade. Choose both to continue.

Field base construction

Buy structures between battles. Repairs and ammunition support nearby squad members; walls block shots and movement. Structures and upgrades remain across runs. Build areas are fixed on your side of the arena.

Unit stats

Stats reflect the selected unit and its equipment. Squad orders and the next-round buff affect combat.

Project board tracks combat systems and future additions.
